name: Felsőlajos (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőlajos (a crowned shield of red and blue with a white church, a tree and a black horse) above the name FELSŐLAJOS in white.
history: The flag of Felsőlajos was adopted on 25 May 2016. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
